Automated release test — iOS-style slider toggle for all switches
iOS-style slider toggle für alle Schalter
Entity Search, Entity Type Icons, Deep Link Support, Quick Settings Tile, Notification Support, GitHub API update check.
Footer buttons at 40% opacity + back button navigation in Settings/Switches.
Opaque footer buttons + navigation slide animations.
Footer buttons now reach display edges by removing bottom padding from main column.
Footer buttons now extend to display edges with no outer border.
Footer buttons now have inner-rounded corners (toward the gap) with a centered gap between them.
No PC status shown under VPN status, all switches use PowerToggle style, PC status checked immediately on toggle, improved footer with transparent cards.
PC status check immediately on VPN connect, no PC status flicker on app open, Unklar status when offline, single status indicator above switch, unified toggle design for all switches.
Faster status updates — watchdog 5s, PC status check 10s.
Fixed WebSocket call_service protocol — all button presses now work correctly.
Fixed toggle button for light/switch entities (use toggle service instead of press).
Direct PC status check via network (TCP socket), no HA dependency for PC status.
Dynamic status display via WebSocket, real-time An/Aus status, state entity support.
Restored old settings screen alongside new switch list screen.
Fixed settings navigation and VPN disconnect Toast crash.
Multi-switch support — configure multiple switches with toggle/dual types, carousel on main screen, drag & drop sorting.
Instant VPN disconnect — probe immediately after disconnect, no 3s delay.
VPN detection fix — only OpenVPN shows VPN badge, Tailscale shows Remote.
VPN detection fix — shows VPN badge when OpenVPN active, disconnect button always visible.
Token Visibility Toggle mit pixel-art gothic eye icon.
Verbesserte Lesbarkeit (hellerer Text, dunklere GlassCards).
Update-Fehlerbehandlung verbessert.
Verbesserte Lesbarkeit und GlassCard-Design.
Alle Einstellungen + Setup-Fenster.
Netzwerk-Einstellungen im SettingsScreen.
SettingsScreen mit Update-Prüfung, Versions-Anzeige, Changelog-Dialog, Retry-Button, Rollback-Support.
Update-Flow Fix.
VPN-Detection Fix, Power-Toggle Switch, Version-Display in Settings
Dark Cyber Gothic Design, Squircles, Glassmorphism, Back-Button Fix, Update-Button Animation
Connect-to-Home bei Offline und Remote, Heimnetz-Trennen bei VPN, Entity-Cards entfernt, Update-Button in Einstellungen
APK-only, PWA removed. Native Android app with Connect-to-Home, HA-WebSocket client, self-update.
APK mit clearCache-on-cold-start (stale SW blockierte Update-Button)
